translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Lasalo yana alika faꞋina.
Tu kaliva saꞋeyana giꞋaulolo, ana egana Lasalo yana melala Bedani, medema Meli kadu tobohiyana Mata badi buye yadi melala.
Bana Meli higa muliya Kaiwabu agena bunama againe gibunamina ada agena uꞋuna tunugina againe giluvehavehayana, au bana kwamayoku-nadi nouna Lasalo giꞋaulolo.
GiꞋaulolo tu vevine adiꞋiselu venuwaꞋata Yesu againe hiꞋiveninisena higayo, “Kauveya, tobohiya banaꞋe nuwanuwa lakahina amanadi giꞋaulolo lakahina.”
Tu Yesu ginogalini-yo au gigayo, “Yana aulolo lakahina tu keke vaita ginaꞋalika amine, au yana aulolo againe Yaubada yana kikaiwabu ginaꞋiveyemaunina be Iya Bana Natuna kaliva hinakilakahiku.”
Au higa Yesu nuwanuwana Mata kadu tobohiyana be noudi Lasalo buyeꞋi, nuwanuwana badiꞋiyao.
Ada au Lasalo giꞋaulolo ma ginogalini-yo kadu aimo yuwa Yolidani fafaline gimiyami aiyeta luhei, keke gidamadulowoga.
Aiyeta luhei gimiyami tu ime ana tomuliya gigahema gigayo, “WaꞋela be kana Yudiya ana fafali againe kanayewada.”
Ime ana tomuliya agahena agayo, “Tovehawala, boi tova kabiꞋona kahegena tu miYuda yama tonagona nuwanuwadi O hinatutuveꞋalika. KaꞋi badi agaidiya kanayewa? Vaita hidedei kadamiya.”

Bana Yesu gigayo, “WaꞋita, aiyeta saꞋeyana againe kauwana yana mahalina bai tuwelo ginunauwena. Ada au kaꞋi hakwadi uyadeyadeya ginanunudadana amine o bana keke ginatutumadumadu, faꞋina babi ana mahalina kauwana yana eda gituvemahalina.
Tu kaꞋi kaliva uyuyuya ginanunudadana amine o bana ginatutumadumadu, faꞋina yana mahalina keke.”

Au hidede amine Yesu gigahe (higa vaita mena tovai-nadi aimo uyadayada faꞋina keke vita ginanuhagani tu uyuyu ginayemu-yo kaliva hinaluveꞋalikana.) Au kadu gigahema gigayo, “Tobohiyada Lasalo giꞋenonuwaulu tu Iya ganana be ganaluvaguna faꞋina.”
Au ime ana tomuliya agahena agayo, “Kauveya, kaꞋi giꞋenonuwaulu, au enonuwaulu againe ginabwaina.” Hidedemi agahe.
Tu Yesu Lasalo yana alika faꞋina gilukahihi tu ime avaita dauva-moꞋa faꞋina gidalukahihi.

Ime afaniyena faꞋina, Yesu gigahe-moꞋema gigayo, “Lasalo a giꞋalika, ada tova gilubodana be omi wanavetumaganeku. Medema faꞋina bana giꞋalika againe Iya bana buye keke adamiyami faꞋina gavemwamwala be higa tova adamoya wanavetumagane-moꞋeku. Au kanana kanaꞋitana.”
Hidedemi Yesu gigahe-yo au Tomasi, bana ana egana Natuluga, ime tomuliya velugameyao gigahema gigayo, “Au ide buye kana be kaꞋalika.”
Yesu alika be mididi-havagi faꞋina Mata buye hilukahihi.
Tu Lasalo ahe hitau-yo aiyeta fowa ahegedi tu muliya Yesu gilakayemu Bedani melala againe.
Ma Bedani medema Yelusalema liline, ana lauva kaꞋi kilomita tohiye amine.
Ada au miYuda moyaꞋaidi Mata be Meli agaidiya hiyemu be noudi yana alika faꞋina hinaꞋivemoluvidi.
Ada bana Mata Yesu giꞋelaꞋela-ma valeyana ginogalini-yo au gilowoga be ginamadubodebodena, tu bana Meli ma gimiya manuweya.
Au Mata giyemu Yesu againe gigahe gigayo, “Ho Kauveya, kaꞋi O hidedei udamiyami digo, nouku keke gidaꞋalika.
Tu ahe nouku giꞋalika, atu gahalamanena kaꞋi gavadi Yaubada againe unaveꞋoꞋolena, medema BanaꞋe ginavele.”
Au Yesu gigayo, “Nou ginamididi-havagi.”
Au Mata gigayo, “A gahalamanena bana ginamididi-havagi aimo tova mulina Yaubada kaliva alikeya ginasivemidididi vedewayauga ana toveya. Hidedema gahalamanena.”

Bana Yesu gigayo, “IyaꞋeku mididi-havagi inubana, kadu IyaꞋeku kaliva yawaimi ivaguna inubana. Gava kaliva ginavetuvetumaganeku, medema keke ginaꞋalika au wayawaina ivaguna ginamiyamiya-vagata. KaꞋi bana kalivai-nadi wowona ginaꞋalika, tu tauna ginamiyamiya-vagata.
Ada gaveyao wayawaidi himimiyami kadu Iya hivetuvetumaganeku, medema keke-moꞋa hinaꞋalika-vagata. KaꞋi hida yaku gahe uvetumaganena?”

Yesu hidedemi gitoliluvaluva-yo Mata gigayo, “Ika Kauveya, iya gavetumagane, OꞋeni velemona Yaubada yana Tovegida Keliso. E, OꞋeni Yaubada Natuna, O Kalivai-nina faꞋiniya abodaboda be uhobuꞋela babiya.”
Ada au Mata hidedemi gigahe-yo gilowoga tobohiyana Meli againe giyewana, giluwahiyena be giꞋalakululuyena gigayo, “Bana yada Tovehawala a giꞋela, nuwanuwana o unana be ginaꞋita.”
Ada Meli tobohiyana yana gahe ginogalini-yo au gitowamidi Yesu againe gimaduna.
Yesu gitagitagi.
Meli ginauna tu Yesu aimo keke gidayemu melaleya, au edeya Mata ginuhagana againe aimo gimiyami.
Ada miYuda ahe hiꞋela, bana Meli buye manuweya himiyami hihawavemoluvina. Au Meli gitowamidi manuweya gimaduhobu ma hiꞋita-yo au himuliyena, hivaita bana gidanauna tomohuyehuyeya gidatagiya.
Badi himuliyena tu bana Meli Yesu againe gilakayemu, giꞋita tu agene giꞋiboꞋula-moꞋa gigahena gigayo, “Ho Kauveya, kaꞋi O hidedei udamiyami digo, nouku keke gidaꞋalika.”
Ada bana Meli gitagitagi-lulaukuhi, kadu miYuda bana hibwaꞋulina-ma kadu buye hiveꞋalulaukuhi. Ada au Yesu yadi tagiya giꞋita-yo alika faꞋina giꞋilaꞋa kadu nuwana gikabubu.
Au gigayo, “Hai watau?” Badi higayo, “Kauveya, uꞋela be kana uꞋita.”
Ada au Yesu gitagitagi.
Ada bana Yesu gitagitagi faꞋina, badi miYuda higayo, “WaꞋita. Wona velemona nuwanuwana lakahina banaꞋe.”
Tu tufoidi higayo, “KaꞋi hida kaliva gidamaduꞋela toꞋaulolo gidamaduꞋitana digo, anafaiweya gidavelugana be keke gidaꞋalika, faꞋina bana tomatakoyo matana gikiyauna, au ana tagalowalowa.”
Yesu Lasalo alikeya gisivemididina.
Tu Yesu alika faꞋina kadu giꞋilaꞋa, au gilowoga abaꞋaitauna againe gina. AbaꞋaitauna higa tomohuyahuya, ada kabala lakahina abaluku gisebodana.
Au Yesu gigayo, “Kabala wavaini.” Tu bana Mata toꞋalika nouna gigahena gigayo, “Kauveya, bana hima gilada, faꞋina hitau-yo aiyeta fowa kahegena.”
Bana Yesu gigahena gigayo, “Au yaku gahe udanuwa-nunauyena ahe gagahe gagayo, KaꞋi unavetumaganeku o, Yaubada yana kikaiwabu unaꞋitana.”
Ada au kabala hivaina digo Yesu giꞋitalele gigayo, “Kamaku, gavesiule againiya ahe uvenogaleku faꞋina.

Ada a gahalamanena uvenovenogaleku tova moyaꞋaina, tu O againiya gavesiule be badi lilikuya himidimidi-ma hinanogalina. Hinanogali-yo au hinahalamane-moꞋena O Tauni uꞋiveniniseku be gahobuꞋela.” Hidedemi Yesu Tamana againe gigahe.
Ada au giveꞋoꞋola gihavaina, gikovaꞋawafatafata gigayo, “Lasalo-yo, uyemu.”

Yesu gigahe-yo bana toꞋalika giyemu, nimana agena kaleko againe boi miYuda yama dewa amine hifafana-ma aimo gidauda. KaduꞋe kaleko uꞋune hifafana-ma aimo gidauda. Au Yesu kaliva gigahedi gigayo, “Wanayauna be ginana.”
MiYuda yadi tonagona hivevai be Yesu hinaluveꞋalikana.
Tu miYuda Meli againe hiꞋela hihawavemoluvina amanadi, tufoidi moyaꞋaidi Yesu nimana ana iyaꞋiyaya hiꞋita-yo BanaꞋe hivetumaganena.
Tu tufoidi badi tonagona tafatafalolodiyao adi egana Falisi agaidiya hina Yesu yana gugai faꞋina hiꞋawatalatalaina.

HiꞋawatalatalaina gihavaina, badi Falisi kadu abaveyao ana tofaisewa kikaiwabudiyao venuwaꞋata hiꞋiveninisena be koniselo yadi vagaꞋauta hisena. Ada hivagaꞋauta-yo hiveꞋagahegahe higayo, “Gavaimi kanagani? Bana wadema kalivai-nadi nimana ana iyaꞋiyaya moyaꞋai-moꞋena gififaisewana.

KaꞋi keke kanahawatani digo, kaliva matatabudi hinavetumagana-Ꞌowoga ada badi yada tovehimeya miLoma yadi tolugaviya hinaꞋiveninisedi be yada manuwa-tafalolo hinayawelina, kadu ide miYuda moyaꞋaida yada kaiwabu hinavaihegena.” Hidede amine hiveꞋagahegahe.

Tu kaliva saꞋeyana badi agaidiya gimiyami, ana egana Kaiyafasi, bana abaveyao ana tofaisewa adi tokaiwabu hisena medema malamalai-nadi againe. Au bana Kaiyafasi gigahedi gigayo, “Omi kwavakwavamiyao. Gilubodana be kaliva saꞋeyanaga ginaꞋalika ma maꞋi wanuwenuwena o kaꞋi keke? KaꞋi ide miYuda moyaꞋaida miLoma nimadiya kanaꞋalika-Ꞌowoga kadu yada yoꞋo hinakwaha, medema keke gidalubodani.”

Ma bana Kaiyafasi keke tauna yana nuwanuwa againe hidede amine gidagahe, au bana medema malamalai-nadi againe abaveyao ana tofaisewa adi tokaiwabu ana maka givaina faꞋina, Yaubada nuwanuwa givelena be gavadi aimo ginalakayemu ma gilukahihiyena, higa Yesu miYuda yana yoꞋo faꞋimeya ginaꞋalika.

Kadu keke vaita yana yoꞋo gagana faꞋimeya ginaꞋalika, tu kadu badi Yaubada natuneyao moyaꞋaidi faꞋidiya ginaꞋalika be badi kalivai-dina fafali tulina tulina agaidiya himiyamiyavehaila amanadi Yaubada yana yoꞋo saꞋeyana againe hinavetobohiyana faꞋina.
Ada au medema aiyetai-nadi hivebutu hivevai, tova moyaꞋaina hinuwanuwa be Yesu hinaluveꞋalikana faꞋina.

Badi nuwanuwadi Yesu hinaluveꞋalikana faꞋina, Bana miYuda yama tonagona hinafadiya aimo keke gidanaudadana, au gilowoga fafali saꞋeyana babigaga liline gina melala ana egana Ifilaimo againe gimiyami. Ada medede againe Bana ime ana tomuliya buye amiyami.

Tu miYuda yama tafalolo lakahina giluvedavedaꞋufo, ana egana lobama ana tovenuwaꞋata yana Abamaduviviya, ada moyaꞋaidi melala tulina tulina agaidiya hitauya, hinauna Yelusalema be hinakiveyeveyegadi yama tafalolo ana dewa amine.
Ada Yesu hilelelena, manuwa-tafalolo againe himidimidi tu hiveꞋagahegahe higayo, “Gavaimi wanuwanuwa? KaꞋi Yesu hida tafalolo againe ginaꞋela o kaꞋi keke?”
Tu abaveyao ana tofaisewa kikaiwabudiyao kadu Falisi vehimeya ahe hisena higa kaꞋi tamo kaliva haꞋagaine Yesu gimiyami-ma ginahalamanena o, ginahawavemogatala badi agaidiya be hinakiveꞋavina faꞋina.
